equation_summary: Per pair (i,j): s_ij = sum_n q_in k_jn exp2(P_in - P_jn) * scale * RCP_LN2, where P is the prefix cumsum of a per-channel log2 gate g [B,T,HQ,K]; optional additional FoX-style per-head scalar cumulative gate; causal/window/varlen mask; base-2 softmax with max-shift stabilization and optional sink bias; output = weights @ v. The per-channel decay enters *inside* the channel sum of the dot product, so it is not expressible as an additive pairwise logit bias.
state_shape: external KV cache; optional sink bias and per-head scalar gate
gate_scope: data-dependent per-channel log-decay gate (plus optional per-head scalar gate)
normalization: softmax (base-2, max-shifted, optional sink in denominator)
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM E[QKV/per-channel gates] ; B[K1 channel-decay score] ; E[optional gate/sink/window/cache] matches naive_wall_attn: channel-decay score with optional sink/window/varlen branches.

CONFIRM the blocker: stable interval decay evaluation and the optional branches must be pinned, and no scalar-bias approximation is valid because the per-channel decay sits inside the channel contraction (sum_n q k 2^(P_in - P_jn)).
axis: A13 score/reducer algebra (channel-decay score modulation; scalar-gate special case shared with arch-008 FoX)
direction_justification: The mixer differs from U1.S by a closed typed score property (per-channel interval decay inside the dot product), reusable in its scalar form by FoX, hence an axis with independent references before any native path.
open_questions: Scalar-per-head gate (g_scalar) and channel gate coexist in the source; whether one descriptor subsumes both (channel gate with broadcast) needs a proven equivalence, and the ledger correctly forbids merging them by name.
